notes.title: FREE TO PLAY
notes.content: Hi, it has been a while since my last interaction with this community. I doubt anyone actually reads any of these, but I have to make an announcement about the game becoming f2p. I had fun making this game and watching people play it, all those jumpscares and stuff. It was never about the money, it was always about having fun. That is probably the biggest mistake for newbie game developers. I myself am not a developer anymore, it is too competitive to make a living out there. This game alone took my +10 months of work and it didn't pay back even a slight bit. So i'm making the game free to play, hope you enjoy. The effect will take notice in the next few days.Thanks for reading, have a nice day!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 Day/Night cycle.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32195765/8cc75e39de2939882374f97dd881cdf8acaef4f5.png[/img]


Today I was able to reduce and fix a number of glitches, bugs and added a day/night cycle in the game for all maps. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/rW383Tu] Discord [/url] community!

[list]
    [*]Added day/night cycle.
    [*]Added Mouse Sensitivity slider.
    [*]Optimization/smaller game file.
    [*]Fixed glitches between rocks.
    [*]Battery now reduces more slowly.
    [*]Added bigger chance for monster to hear the noise.
    [*]Footage fills up more quickly.
    [*]Flashlight is now much more intense.
    [*]Camera now can capture beasts from a longer distance.
    [*]Fixed few map/character bugs.
[/list]
